tip: gelince means when it comes. The -ince ending marks the moment one action triggers another, so no separate word for when is needed.
kazanmış uses the -mış past for things you did not witness yourself, giving a sense of apparently or so I heard rather than a plain fact.
olduktan sonra means after becoming. The -dıktan sonra pattern on a verb marks doing the main action after that one finishes.
gelene kadar means until you come. The -ene kadar ending sets a deadline that the main action reaches or finishes by.
danışsaydın is the if you had consulted form. The -saydın ending marks a past condition that did not actually happen.
Gördüğüm means that I saw and describes manzara. The -dığım ending turns a verb into a relative clause modifying the following noun.
